'''R2-L3''' was an [[Astromech droid/Legends|astromech]] [[Droid/Legends|droid]] present in [[Mos Espa/Legends|Mos Espa]] during the time that [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] went to ask [[Watto/Legends|Watto]] about [[Shmi Skywalker Lars/Legends|Shmi Skywalker's]] whereabouts. R2-L3 had a red body with blue and yellow panels.

During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], R2-L3 was owned by the [[Slicer/Legends|slicer]] [[Jyss Cordam]].<ref name="FBS">''[[Flashpoint! Brak Sector]]''</ref>
